movements that let you progressively overload.
Today's workout










1. EZ-Bar Preacher Curl

BICEPS • 3 sets × 8–12 reps

Focus on a controlled eccentric and getting close to full elbow extension without forcing the bottom position.

Rest: 90 sec













2. Overhead Cable Triceps Extension

TRICEPS • 3 sets × 10–15 reps

Emphasizes the long head of the triceps. Let your elbows bend deeply for a good stretch.

Rest: 90 sec













3. Incline Dumbbell Curl

BICEPS • 3 sets × 10–12 reps

Keep your upper arms behind your torso. Avoid swinging or bringing your elbows forward.

Rest: 75–90 sec













4. Rope Triceps Pushdown

TRICEPS • 3 sets × 10–15 reps

Keep elbows fixed at your sides. Extend fully without using your shoulders to drive the weight.

Rest: 75–90 sec













5. Dumbbell Hammer Curl

BRACHIALIS + BRACHIORADIALIS • 3 sets × 10–15 reps

Keep palms facing inward. Particularly useful for adding overall arm thickness.

Rest: 75 sec













6. Seated Wrist Curl

FOREARM FLEXORS • 2 sets × 15–20 reps

Support your forearms and move only at the wrists. Use a full, controlled range.

Rest: 60 sec













7. Reverse Wrist Curl

FOREARM EXTENSORS • 2 sets × 15–20 reps

Palms face down. Use light weights and avoid momentum.

Rest: 60 sec
